name: Industrial Waste Management
description: An integrated approach to industrial waste and wastewater management, covering both the nature and characteristics of solid wastes and wastewater; pollution prevention, control strategies, and the use of clean process tools such as reuse, recycle, and recovery, alongside source reduction and process modifications; analytical methods like flow sheet analysis, energy and water audits, and waste and emission inventories; management hierarchies, zero discharge concepts, and environmental indicators, along with a detailed review of regulations; case studies from diverse industries illustrate practical applications in reducing environmental impacts and promoting sustainable industrial practices.
